description: A deterministic SmallBank-inspired trace set for TVCache. Each fresh rollout starts from the same three-account SQLite seed.

rollouts.name: first-transfer
rollouts.purpose: Populate the cache with a transfer sequence and its snapshots.

calls.query: SELECT a.custid, a.name, c.bal_cents, s.bal_cents, c.bal_cents + s.bal_cents AS total_cents FROM accounts AS a JOIN checking AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN savings AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE a.custid = ?
UPDATE checking SET bal_cents = bal_cents + CASE custid WHEN ? THEN ? WHEN ? THEN ? END WHERE custid IN (?, ?) AND (SELECT bal_cents FROM checking WHERE custid = ?) >= ?

UPDATE checking SET bal_cents = bal_cents + CASE custid WHEN ? THEN ? WHEN ? THEN ? END WHERE custid IN (?, ?) AND (SELECT bal_cents FROM checking WHERE custid = ?) >= ?

rollouts.name: equivalent-sql-spelling
rollouts.purpose: Alternate SQL syntax produces the same database state, but exact matching executes the changed statements.
